font_for.brief: 取样式对应的字体对象 / Fetch the font object for a style
font_for.return: 匹配字号/字重/字体族的字体 / Font matching the size, weight and family

resolve_len.brief: 解析长度值（含 em/rem/vw/vh/ch 等相对单位）/ Resolve a length value including relative units like `em`/`rem`/`vw`/`vh`/`ch`

params.ctx: in:布局上下文，可为 NULL / Layout context, may be NULL
params.len: in:待解析的长度 / Length to resolve
params.base: in:百分比等相对长度所依据的基准 / Basis for percentages and other relative lengths

resolve_len.return: 解析后的像素长度 / Resolved length in pixels
resolve_len.note: `ch` 需要元素自身字体中 `0` 字形的步进宽度 / `ch` needs the advance of the `0` glyph in the element's own font

side_px.brief: 解析盒子边（padding/border/尺寸）长度并截断负值 / Resolve a box-side length, clamping negatives to zero

params.len: in:待解析的长度 / Length to resolve
params.base: in:相对长度基准 / Basis for relative lengths

side_px.return: 非负的像素长度 / Non-negative length in pixels

margin_px.brief: 解析外边距长度（可为负，`auto` 视为 0）/ Resolve a margin length, negative allowed, `auto` as 0

params.base: in:相对长度基准 / Basis for relative lengths

margin_px.return: 像素外边距 / Margin in pixels
margin_px.note: `auto` 由块级/flex 流程自行分配后写回具体像素值 / The block and flex passes resolve `auto` themselves and write a concrete px length back

style_line_height.brief: 求样式对应的行高 / Resolve the line height of a style
style_line_height.return: 行高（像素）/ Line height in pixels
style_line_height.note: `line-height` 为负时按字号比例换算，为 0 时回退到字体自身的行高 / A negative `line-height` is a factor of the font size; 0 falls back to the font's own line height

is_cjk.brief: 判断码点是否落在 CJK 范围 / Test whether a code point lies in a CJK range

params.cp: in:Unicode 码点 / Unicode code point

is_cjk.return: 属于 CJK 返回 1，否则 0 / 1 for a CJK code point, else 0

resolve_margins.brief: 把四边外边距解析进数组 / Resolve the four margin sides into an array

params.base: in:相对长度基准 / Basis for relative lengths
params.m: out:接收 top/right/bottom/left 外边距 / Receives margins in top/right/bottom/left order

collapse_margins.brief: 按 CSS 2.1 §8.3.1 折叠两个相邻垂直外边距 / Collapse two adjoining vertical margins per CSS 2.1 §8.3.1

params.a: in:第一个外边距 / First margin
params.b: in:第二个外边距 / Second margin

collapse_margins.return: 折叠后的外边距 / Collapsed margin
collapse_margins.note: 同为正经取较大者，同为负取更负者，异号取和 / Both positive takes the larger, both negative the more negative, mixed signs their sum

text_spacing.brief: 解析 letter-spacing 与 word-spacing / Resolve `letter-spacing` and `word-spacing`

params.base: in:相对长度基准 / Basis for relative lengths

text_spacing.return: 字形间距参数 / Glyph spacing parameters
text_spacing.note: 负 letter-spacing 不支持，按 0 处理 / Negative tracking is not modelled and is clamped to 0

box_shift.brief: 在文档坐标中平移一个盒及其整棵子树 / Translate a box and its whole subtree in document space

params.box: inout:待平移的盒 / Box to translate
params.dx: in:X 方向偏移 / Delta X
params.dy: in:Y 方向偏移 / Delta Y

box_shift.note: 同时平移三个盒矩形与所有行的 y / Shifts all three box rects and every line's y as well

box_new.brief: 新建一个零初始化的布局盒 / Create a zero-initialised layout box
box_new.return: 新分配的盒 / Newly allocated box

box_append.brief: 把一个盒追加为父盒的最后一个子盒 / Append a box as the parent's last child

params.child: inout:待追加的子盒 / Child box to append

build_svg_box.brief: 为 `<svg>` 元素构造替换块盒 / Build the replaced block box for an `<svg>` element

params.node: in:`<svg>` DOM 节点 / The `<svg>` DOM node

build_svg_box.return: 对应的块盒 / The corresponding block box
build_svg_box.note: 固有尺寸取自 `width`/`height` 属性；子树由 hpe_svg_paint 直接从 DOM 绘制，不建盒 / Intrinsic size comes from the `width`/`height` attributes; the subtree is painted from the DOM by hpe_svg_paint instead of being turned into boxes

build_children.brief: 递归构建节点的子盒 / Recursively build the child boxes of a node

params.box: inout:父盒 / Parent box
params.node: in:父 DOM 节点 / Parent DOM node

build_children.note: 元素子节点递归建盒，文本子节点生成文本盒 / Element children recurse; text children become text boxes

build_element.brief: 为一个元素构建盒子树 / Build the box subtree for one element

params.node: in:元素 DOM 节点 / Element DOM node

build_element.return: 根盒；`display:none` 时返回 `NULL` / The root box, or `NULL` for `display:none`
build_element.note: 绝对/固定定位盒块化，浮动盒作为原子行内级（收缩适应）盒处理 / Absolutely and fixed positioned boxes blockify; floated boxes become atomic inline-level shrink-to-fit boxes

para_add.brief: 向段落追加一个文本片段 / Append a text segment to a paragraph

params.len: in:文本字节长度 / Segment byte length

para_add_atomic.brief: 向段落追加一个原子行内盒片段 / Append an atomic inline-level segment to a paragraph

params.box: in:原子行内块盒 / Atomic inline-block box

collect_inline.brief: 收集行内级内容到段落 / Collect inline-level content into a paragraph

params.box: inout:待收集的盒 / Box to collect
params.para: out:接收内容的段落 / Paragraph receiving the content

collect_inline.note: 行内块盒在此先行排版以便行构建器得知其尺寸；浮动盒被跳过 / Inline-block boxes are laid out here so the line builder knows their size; floated boxes are skipped

line_begin.brief: 在块中开启一条新行 / Open a new line in a block
line_begin.return: 新行的下标 / Index of the new line
line_begin.note: 必要时扩容行数组 / Grows the line array when needed

line_add_run.brief: 向行追加一个文本 run / Append a text run to a line

params.x: in:相对内容盒的 X 位置 / X relative to the content box

line_add_run.note: 颜色取自 run 样式 / The colour is taken from the run style

band_edges.brief: 求区间内浮动态带留给行盒的水平范围 / Compute the horizontal span a float band leaves for line boxes in a y-range

params.cb_x: in:包含块内容区左边界 / Content-box left of the container
params.cb_w: in:包含块内容区宽度 / Content-box width of the container
params.out_left: out:可用左边界 / Available left edge
params.out_right: out:可用右边界 / Available right edge

band_edges_inherited.brief: 沿同一 BFC 的祖先链合并浮动态带范围 / Merge float band extents along the ancestor chain of the same BFC

params.block: in:目标块盒 / Target block box
params.out_left: out:可用左边界 / Available left edge
params.out_right: out:可用右边界 / Available right edge

band_edges_inherited.note: 结果夹紧到块自身的内容盒；浮动祖先本身即是 BFC，遍历到此为止 / The result is clamped to the block's own content box; a floated ancestor is itself a BFC, so the walk stops there

line_measure.brief: 从行的 runs 度量行高、基线与右边界 / Measure a line's height, baseline and right edge from its runs
line_measure.note: 原子盒以盒底为基线；无字体的 run 被跳过 / Atomic boxes sit on their bottom edge; runs without a font are skipped

line_place_atomics.brief: 按 vertical-align 放置行上的原子行内盒 / Position the line's atomic inline boxes per `vertical-align`
line_place_atomics.note: 默认 `baseline` 使盒底对齐行基线，其余关键字相对行盒解析 / The default `baseline` drops the box so its bottom sits on the line baseline; other keywords resolve against the line box

finalize_line.brief: 确定一行的最终度量并应用 text-align / Finalise one line's metrics and apply `text-align`

params.row_y: inout:纵向游标，按行高推进 / Vertical cursor, advanced by the line height

finalize_line.note: 空行使用块字体的行高、基线取行高的 0.8 / An empty line takes the block font's line height with a baseline at 0.8 of it

para_open_line.brief: 开启一条新行并固定其浮动感知的可用范围 / Open a new line and fix its float-aware available span

params.ps: inout:段落排版状态 / Paragraph layout state
params.lh_est: in:估算行高 / Estimated line height

para_open_line.note: 待应用的首行缩进在此前移笔位 / A pending first-line indent shifts the pen position here

para_close_line.brief: 关闭当前行并推进纵向游标 / Close the current line and advance the vertical cursor

params.ps: inout:段落排版状态 / Paragraph layout state

para_place_atomic.brief: 放置一个原子行内盒，必要时换行 / Place one atomic inline box, wrapping when it does not fit

params.ps: inout:段落排版状态 / Paragraph layout state
params.ab: inout:原子行内块盒 / Atomic inline-block box

para_place_atomic.note: 为其预留左边距 + 边框盒宽 + 右边距 / Reserves its left margin plus border-box width plus right margin

para_hard_break.brief: 以一个硬换行结束当前行 / End the current line with a hard break

params.ps: inout:段落排版状态 / Paragraph layout state
params.style: in:换行所在样式（用于空行行高）/ Style of the break, used for an empty line's height

para_place_space.brief: 放置一个空白字形 / Place one whitespace glyph

params.ps: inout:段落排版状态 / Paragraph layout state
params.preserve: in:保留空白模式为 1 / 1 in a preserve-whitespace mode
params.cp: in:空白码点 / Whitespace code point

para_place_space.note: 非保留模式下折叠为 pending_space，由下一个单词输出 / In non-preserve modes the space collapses into `pending_space`, emitted by the next word

text_measure_cluster.brief: 度量一个非空白文本簇（单个 CJK 字或一段非空白非 CJK 字符）/ Measure one non-space cluster: a lone CJK char or a run of non-space non-CJK chars

params.end: in:文本结束指针 / Text end pointer

text_measure_cluster.return: 指向簇后一字节的指针 / Pointer just past the cluster
text_measure_cluster.note: 遇到空白、换行或 CJK 字符即停止 / Stops at whitespace, newline or a CJK character

para_emit_word.brief: 输出一个已度量的文本簇，应用待处理空格并在放不下时换行 / Emit one measured cluster, applying a pending collapsed space and wrapping when it no longer fits

params.ps: inout:段落排版状态 / Paragraph layout state
params.preserve: in:保留空白模式为 1 / 1 in a preserve-whitespace mode
params.wrap: in:允许换行为 1 / 1 to allow wrapping
params.chunk_len: in:簇字节长度 / Cluster byte length

para_place_text.brief: 按 white-space 模式排版一个文本片段 / Lay out one text segment per its `white-space` mode

params.ps: inout:段落排版状态 / Paragraph layout state
params.seg: in:待排版片段 / Segment to lay out

para_place_text.note: 源文本中的换行在 pre/pre-wrap/pre-line 下断行 / Source newlines break the line under pre, pre-wrap and pre-line

flush_paragraph.brief: 把累积的段落排版成行 / Lay the accumulated paragraph out into lines

params.para: inout:段落，排完后清空 / Paragraph, emptied afterwards

flush_paragraph.note: 段落为空时直接返回 / Returns immediately when the paragraph is empty

layout_inline_block.brief: 排版一个行内块盒 / Lay out an inline-block box

params.box: inout:行内块盒 / Inline-block box
params.parent_inner_w: in:父内容区宽度 / Parent inner width

layout_inline_block.note: 有显式宽度时按该宽度排版，否则收缩适应 / Uses an explicit width when present, otherwise shrink-to-fit

measure_preferred_w.brief: 测量内在（收缩适应）边框盒宽度 / Measure the natural shrink-to-fit border-box width

params.box: inout:待测量的盒 / Box to measure

measure_preferred_w.return: 内在边框盒宽度 / Intrinsic border-box width
measure_preferred_w.note: 以极大可用宽度排版以免折行，再取真实内容范围 / Lays out with a huge available width so text does not wrap, then takes the real content extent

find_containing_block.brief: 求最近定位祖先的 padding 盒 / Find the nearest positioned ancestor's padding box

params.box: in:目标盒 / Target box

find_containing_block.return: 包含块矩形；无定位祖先时返回视口矩形 / The containing block rect, or the viewport when no positioned ancestor exists

abspos_inset.brief: 解析一条定位 inset 边，`auto` 返回 0 / Resolve one positioning inset edge, returning 0 for `auto`

params.ref: in:解析基准长度 / Reference length

abspos_inset.return: 该边的像素偏移，`auto` 时为 0 / Pixel offset of the edge, 0 when `auto`

abspos_width.brief: 求绝对定位盒的 used 宽度 / Compute the used width of an absolutely positioned box

params.box: inout:定位盒 / Positioned box
params.cb: in:包含块矩形 / Containing block rect
params.hasL: in:左侧 inset 非 auto 为 1 / 1 when the left inset is not `auto`
params.hasR: in:右侧 inset 非 auto 为 1 / 1 when the right inset is not `auto`

abspos_width.return: used 宽度（非负）/ Used width, clamped to non-negative
abspos_width.note: 依次取显式宽度、两侧 inset 拉伸、收缩适应 / Prefers an explicit width, then stretching between both insets, then shrink-to-fit

layout_abspos.brief: 相对包含块放置一个绝对/固定定位盒 / Position an absolutely/fixed positioned box against its containing block

params.box: inout:定位盒 / Positioned box

layout_abspos.note: 固定定位以视口为包含块；同时给出上下 inset 且高度 auto 时拉伸到包含块 / Fixed positioning uses the viewport as containing block; when both top and bottom insets are given and the height is `auto` the box stretches to the containing block

float_band_push.brief: 向浮动态带追加一段浮动态记录 / Append one float extent to the band

params.top: in:上边界（文档坐标）/ Top edge in document coordinates
params.bottom: in:下边界（文档坐标）/ Bottom edge in document coordinates
params.left: in:左边界（文档坐标）/ Left edge in document coordinates
params.right: in:右边界（文档坐标）/ Right edge in document coordinates

float_clear_offset.brief: 按 clear 把 y 推到既有浮动之下 / Push y below every same-side float already present, per `clear`
float_clear_offset.return: 清除后的 y / Adjusted y

float_dodge_below.brief: 求与区间重叠浮动的最低底边 / Lowest bottom of the floats overlapping a vertical span
float_dodge_below.return: 重叠浮动的最低底边；无重叠时为 -1 / Lowest overlapping bottom, or -1 when none overlap

place_float.brief: 把浮动盒放入容器的浮动态带 / Place a floated box into its container's float band

params.cur_y: inout:容器纵向游标 / Container vertical cursor

place_float.note: 先定尺寸并遵守 `clear`，必要时下移到既有浮动之下，再记录浮动范围 / Sizes the box honouring `clear`, dodges downward past existing floats when it does not fit, then records the band extent

flex_cross_offset.brief: 求单个 flex item 的交叉轴偏移 / Cross-axis offset for one flex item

params.outer: in:item 的外尺寸 / Item outer size

flex_cross_offset.note: `stretch` 与不支持的 `baseline` 退化为 `flex-start` / `stretch` and the unsupported `baseline` degrade to `flex-start`

flex_row_free_space.brief: 分配 flex 行主轴上的正剩余空间 / Distribute positive free space on a flex row's main axis

params.items: inout:flex item 数组 / Flex item array
params.n: in:item 个数 / Number of items
params.grow_sum: in:flex-grow 之和 / Sum of flex-grow factors
params.autos: in:auto 外边距个数 / Number of auto margins
params.out_lead: out:主轴前导偏移 / Leading offset on the main axis
params.out_extra: out:item 间额外间距 / Extra spacing between items

flex_row_free_space.note: 顺序为 auto 外边距、flex-grow、justify-content / The order is auto margins, then flex-grow, then `justify-content`

flex_row_align.brief: 在交叉轴上对齐各行 flex item / Align each flex item on the cross axis

params.items: inout:flex item 数组 / Flex item array
params.n: in:item 个数 / Number of items

flex_row_align.return: 交叉轴尺寸 / The cross-axis size
flex_row_align.note: 每个 item 的 `align-self` 优先于容器的 `align-items` / Each item's `align-self` takes precedence over the container's `align-items`

layout_flex_row.brief: 排版一条单行（nowrap）flex 行 / Lay out a single-line (nowrap) flex row

params.box: inout:flex 容器盒 / Flex container box
params.items: inout:flex item 数组 / Flex item array
params.n: in:item 个数 / Number of items
params.inner_h: in:内容区高度基准 / Inner height basis
params.own_h: in:容器自身高度，未定为负 / Container's own height, negative when unset

layout_flex_row.return: 容器的交叉轴（高度）尺寸 / The container's cross-axis (height) size

layout_flex_column.brief: 排版一条单行 flex 列 / Lay out a single-line flex column

params.box: inout:flex 容器盒 / Flex container box
params.items: inout:flex item 数组 / Flex item array
params.n: in:item 个数 / Number of items
params.inner_h: in:内容区高度基准 / Inner height basis
params.own_h: in:容器自身高度，未定为负 / Container's own height, negative when unset

layout_flex_column.return: 容器的交叉轴（高度）尺寸 / The container's cross-axis (height) size
layout_flex_column.note: 列的主轴为纵向，交叉轴水平 / The column's main axis is vertical and its cross axis horizontal

flex_item_width.brief: 求一个 flex item 的主轴（边框盒）尺寸 / Resolve one flex item's main-axis (border-box) size

params.child: inout:item 对应的子盒 / Child box of the item
params.inner_w: in:容器内容区宽度 / Container inner width

flex_item_width.return: 主轴尺寸（非负，夹紧到 min/max 与容器宽度）/ Main-axis size, non-negative, clamped to min/max and the container width
flex_item_width.note: 显式宽度按 box-sizing 加内边距/边框，否则收缩适应 / An explicit width adds padding/border for content-box sizing, otherwise shrink-to-fit

flex_collect_items.brief: 收集流内块级/行内块子盒为 flex items / Collect the in-flow block and inline-block children as flex items

params.box: in:flex 容器盒 / Flex container box
params.out_n: out:收集到的 item 个数 / Number of collected items

flex_collect_items.return: 新分配的 item 数组，调用方负责释放 / Newly allocated item array owned by the caller
flex_collect_items.note: 跳过流外（绝对/固定）与行内/文本子盒 / Out-of-flow boxes and inline/text children are skipped

layout_flex.brief: 排版一个 flex 容器 / Lay out a flex container

params.box: inout:flex 容器盒 / Flex container box
params.inner_h: in:内容区高度基准 / Inner height basis

layout_flex.return: 容器的高度 / The container's height
layout_flex.note: 无 flex item 时仅返回自身高度；主轴方向取自 `flex-direction` / Returns just the own height when there are no items; the main axis comes from `flex-direction`

solve_content_width.brief: 求解块盒的内容宽度 / Solve a block box's content width

params.cb_width: in:包含块宽度 / Containing block width
params.avail_width: in:去掉水平外边距后的可用宽度 / Available width left after the horizontal margins
params.p: in:四边内边距 / Four padding sides
params.b: in:四边边框宽度 / Four border widths

solve_content_width.return: 内容宽度（非负）/ Content width, clamped to non-negative
solve_content_width.note: `box-sizing:border-box` 时显式宽度按边框盒解释，需减去内边距与边框 / With `box-sizing:border-box` an explicit width refers to the border box, so padding and borders are subtracted

block_reset_lines.brief: 清空盒的行列表与浮动态带 / Reset a box's line list and float band

params.box: inout:块盒 / Block box

block_reset_lines.note: 盒可能被多次排版（收缩适应测量、flex 定尺寸），每次都要从干净状态开始 / A box can be laid out more than once (shrink-to-fit measurement, flex sizing), so it starts from a clean state every time

block_resolve_edges.brief: 解析外边距/内边距/边框，并报告上下边缘是否无边框内边距 / Resolve margins, paddings and borders; report whether the top/bottom edges have neither border nor padding

params.m: out:四边外边距（可负）/ Four margin sides, may be negative
params.p: out:四边内边距 / Four padding sides
params.b: out:四边边框宽度 / Four border widths
params.no_top_sep: out:上边缘无边框内边距为 1 / 1 when the top edge has no border or padding
params.no_bottom_sep: out:下边缘无边框内边距为 1 / 1 when the bottom edge has no border or padding

block_resolve_edges.note: 无分隔的相邻边缘允许子外边距折叠穿透 / Edges without a separator let child margins collapse through

block_auto_margins.brief: 分配水平 auto 外边距以居中定宽盒 / Distribute horizontal auto margins to centre a fixed-width box

params.m: inout:四边外边距，auto 侧被写回 / Four margin sides; the auto sides are written back
params.p: in:四边内边距 / Four padding sides
params.b: in:四边边框宽度 / Four border widths

block_auto_margins.note: 宽度为 `auto` 或无 auto 侧时不做处理 / Does nothing when the width is `auto` or neither side is auto

block_flow_block_child.brief: 放置并排版一个流内块级子盒 / Position and lay out one in-flow block child

params.box: inout:父块盒 / Parent block box
params.inner_w: in:父内容区宽度 / Parent inner width
params.inner_h_base: in:内容区高度基准 / Inner height basis
params.m: in:父的四边外边距 / Parent's four margin sides
params.b: in:父的四边边框宽度 / Parent's four border widths
params.no_top_sep: in:父上边缘无分隔为 1 / 1 when the parent's top edge has no separator
params.fl: inout:块级流状态 / Block flow state

block_flow_block_child.note: 首个无上分隔的子盒与父的上外边距折叠 / The first child on a parent without a top separator collapses its top margin with the parent's

block_flow_children.brief: 运行流内子项（块流或 flex）并返回内容底边 / Run the in-flow children (block flow or flex), returning the content bottom

params.box: inout:块盒 / Block box
params.inner_h_base: in:内容区高度基准 / Inner height basis
params.m: in:本盒的四边外边距 / This box's four margin sides
params.b: in:本盒的四边边框宽度 / This box's four border widths
params.no_top_sep: in:上边缘无分隔为 1 / 1 when the top edge has no separator
params.out_had_block: out:是否出现过块级子项 / Whether a block child was seen
params.out_prev_bottom: out:最后一个子项的下外边距 / The last child's bottom margin

block_flow_children.return: 内容底边的文档 y / Content bottom in document coordinates
block_flow_children.note: flex 容器走 flex 分支；浮动子盒离开常规流 / A flex container takes the flex branch; floated children leave the flow

block_resolve_height.brief: 求块盒的内容高度 / Resolve a block box's content height

params.content_h: in:内容范围高度 / Content extent height
params.avail_height: in:可用高度（百分比高度基准）/ Available height, the basis for percentage heights
params.p: in:四边内边距 / Four padding sides
params.b: in:四边边框宽度 / Four border widths

block_resolve_height.return: 内容高度（非负）/ Content height, clamped to non-negative
block_resolve_height.note: 显式高度优先于内容范围，再受 min/max 夹紧 / An explicit height wins over the content extent and is then clamped by min/max

block_apply_relative_offset.brief: 应用 relative 定位偏移 / Apply the `relative` positioning offset

params.box: inout:块盒 / Block box
params.avail_width: in:解析基准宽度 / Reference width for resolution

block_apply_relative_offset.note: 只处理 `position:relative`；须在 abspos 流程之前执行，使后代的包含块使用已平移的 padding 盒 / Only `position:relative` is handled; must run before the abspos pass so descendant containing blocks use the shifted padding box

block_position_abspos_children.brief: 放置流外的绝对/固定定位子盒 / Position the out-of-flow absolutely/fixed positioned children

params.box: inout:块盒 / Block box

block_position_abspos_children.note: 流外后代相对本盒（已平移的）padding 盒定位 / Out-of-flow descendants position against this box's (possibly shifted) padding box

block_content_height.brief: 求内容盒高度：先覆盖浮动，再应用显式/min/max / Content-box height: content extent covering floats, then explicit/min/max

params.box: inout:块盒 / Block box
params.content_h: in:内容范围高度 / Content extent height
params.prev_bottom: in:最后一个子项的下外边距 / The last child's bottom margin
params.had_block: in:曾出现块级子项为 1 / 1 when a block child was seen
params.no_bottom_sep: in:下边缘无分隔为 1 / 1 when the bottom edge has no separator
params.m: in:本盒的四边外边距 / This box's four margin sides
params.p: in:四边内边距 / Four padding sides
params.b: in:四边边框宽度 / Four border widths

block_content_height.note: 块容器延伸以覆盖其浮动子项 / A block container extends to cover its floated children

layout_block.brief: 排版一个块盒 / Lay out a block box

params.box: inout:待排版的块盒 / Block box to lay out
params.x: in:边框盒左上角文档坐标 X / Document X of the margin-box origin
params.y: in:边框盒左上角文档坐标 Y / Document Y of the margin-box origin
params.avail_width: in:可用宽度（margin box）/ Available width, the margin box

layout_block.return: 本盒的外侧高度（上外边距 + 边框盒高 + 下外边距）/ The box's outer height (top margin plus border-box height plus bottom margin)
layout_block.note: 负责解析尺寸、排版子项、求解内容高，并放置流外后代 / Resolves the sizes, lays out the children, solves the content height and positions out-of-flow descendants

box_insert_after.brief: 把盒插入父盒子链表中 ref 之后 / Insert a box after `ref` in a parent's child list

params.ref: in:参照盒；`NULL` 表示插到表头 / Reference box, `NULL` inserts at the head
params.box: inout:待插入的盒 / Box to insert

box_insert_after.note: 顺序与整体构建一致，因为 ref 是生成盒的最近前置 DOM 兄弟 / Produces the same order as a full build, since `ref` is the nearest preceding DOM sibling that generated a box

rebuild_box_in_place.brief: 就地替换某 DOM 节点对应的盒子子树 / Replace the box subtree of one DOM node in place

params.dom: in:发生变更的 DOM 节点 / The mutated DOM node

rebuild_box_in_place.return: 成功返回 1；无法就地替换时返回 0 / 1 on success, 0 when an in-place replacement is not possible
rebuild_box_in_place.note: 只重建 dom 自身子树；文本节点因无标签返回 0，交给整体构建 / Only `dom`'s own subtree is rebuilt; text nodes return 0 because they have no tag for build_element

relayout_existing.brief: 对既有盒子树重跑几何排版 / Re-run the geometry pass over an existing box tree

params.root: inout:盒子树根 / Box tree root
params.vh: in:视口高度；非正时取 4*vw / Viewport height, defaulting to 4*vw when not positive

relayout_existing.note: 不做任何重建，只重算几何并回填反向指针 / Rebuilds nothing; only recomputes geometry and rebinds back pointers

hpe_layout_rebuild.brief: DOM 变更后的增量重建 / Incremental rebuild after a DOM mutation

params.document: in:文档根节点 / Document root node
params.old_root: inout:上一轮的盒子树 / Previous pass's box tree
params.reflow_root: in:子树发生变更的最高 DOM 节点 / Highest DOM node whose subtree changed

hpe_layout_rebuild.return: 成功时返回复用的 old_root；输入不允许局部重建时返回 `NULL` / The reused `old_root` on success, or `NULL` when the inputs do not permit a partial pass
hpe_layout_rebuild.note: 变更子树之外的盒原样复用，只重建从根到 reflow_root 的路径；几何结果与 hpe_layout_build 一致 / Boxes outside the changed subtree are reused verbatim; only the path from the root down to `reflow_root` is rebuilt, and the geometry matches hpe_layout_build

hpe_layout_build.brief: 为文档构建并排版盒子树 / Build and lay out the box tree for a document

params.document: in:文档根节点 / Document root node
params.viewport_height: in:视口高度；非正时取 4*viewport_width / Viewport height, defaulting to 4*viewport_width when not positive

hpe_layout_build.return: 盒子树根；无文档或 `<html>` 时返回 `NULL` / Box tree root, or `NULL` when there is no document or no `<html>`
hpe_layout_build.note: 视口即初始包含块，`height:100%` 与 abspos `bottom:` 都相对它解析 / The viewport is the initial containing block, so `height:100%` and abspos `bottom:` resolve against it

bind_boxes.brief: 回填元素到盒的反向指针 / Fill in element-to-box back pointers

params.box: inout:盒子树根 / Box tree root

bind_boxes.note: 脚本读取 clientWidth/clientHeight 时依赖该指针，须在每次（重新）排版后重建 / Scripts rely on it for clientWidth/clientHeight, so it is rebuilt after every (re)layout

hpe_layout_free.brief: 释放整棵盒子树 / Free an entire box tree

params.box: inout:待释放的盒；可为 `NULL` / Box to free, may be `NULL`

hpe_layout_free.note: 递归释放子盒、各行 runs、行数组与浮动态带，并清空对应 DOM 节点的反向指针 / Recursively frees children, each line's runs, the line array and the float band, clearing the matching DOM back pointer

hpe_layout_content_height.brief: 求根盒的总内容高度 / Total content height of the root box
hpe_layout_content_height.return: 根盒边框盒底边的文档 y；root 为 `NULL` 时返回 0 / Document y of the root's border-box bottom, or 0 when `root` is `NULL`
